headline: What to Do After a Hit and Run Accident in San Diego

publisher.name: Law Office of Angelo J. Reyes, APC

articleBody: Dealing with a hit and run accident can be incredibly stressful, leaving you feeling helpless and unsure of what to do next. But taking the right steps immediately can make a significant difference, especially if you're concerned about legal repercussions. It's not just about property damage; there can be serious criminal charges if you leave the scene. First off, if you're involved in any accident, always stop and exchange information, even if it seems minor. If you weren't the one who left, make sure to report the incident to the police, gather as much information as you can about the other vehicle (like license plate, make, model, color), and take photos of the scene and any damage. This is vital evidence. If *you* were the driver who left the scene and now realize the gravity of the situation, don't panic, but don't ignore it either. Leaving the scene of an accident can carry severe penalties in California, including fines, points on your driving record, license suspension, and even jail time, depending on whether there was injury or death. This is where professional legal help becomes critical. An attorney specializing in hit and run defense can help you understand the charges, explore your options, and work to protect your rights, potentially reducing the impact on your life. Reach out to someone like Attorney Angelo Reyes right away to discuss your situation confidentially.
